query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_condition_parameters (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  condition_set_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  condition_type_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (condition_set_id) REFERENCES test_condition_sets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (condition_type_id) REFERENCES test_condition_types(id),
  UNIQUE KEY unique_set_type (condition_set_id, condition_type_id)
);
